about: A standing constraint on what can be used.

messages.content: Our office laptops can't install anything without IT approval, so everything has to be done in plain Excel. How do I remove duplicate rows?
In Excel: select the range, then Data > Remove Duplicates, and pick the columns that define a duplicate.

right.text: Cannot install software at work; works in plain Excel
